text:
dana: Hey ML team — new model intake: monsoon-13b just landed from ops, requesting perf + quant bring-up. Can we triage priority and checklist?

kai: +1. Quick context: trained on mixed-code+instruction, fp16 baseline. Size ~13B. CI owners: @ravi for perf, @ellie for quality.

ravi: I'll own throughput/latency benching. Plan: 1) coldstart/cold-KV latency 2) steady-state throughput with batching 3) ctx-length sweep (512/1024/2048) 4) quant int8/int4 smoke. Need test harness and sample prompts.

ellie: I'll run evals on our benchmark suite (prompt-suite v3). Priorities: instruction-following, code-gen snippets, hallucination checks. We'll compare BLEU/ROUGE/semantic similarity + human sampled checks for regressions.

ciara: Ops note: model files at s3://redwood-models/monsoon/13b/v1/. Please use dedup-ed cache key monsoon-13b-v1. Also adding to model-catalog ticket #M-1872.

ravi: Proposed microbench command:
```
./bench/run.sh --model monsoon-13b --devices 1 --batch-sizes "1,4,8,16" --ctxs "512,1024,2048" --tokens 1024 --quant-modes "none,int8,int4-smoke" --out results/monsoon-13b/
```
I'll capture p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, GPU-util, and tail latency.

dana: Add these acceptance gates for Dedicated: p95 < 250ms @batch=1/ctx=512 on a75/p4d, throughput > 800 tok/s @batch=8/ctx=1024. Also quant-int8 should not degrade instruction acceptance score > 2%.

ellie: For evals I'll run:
- prompt-suite v3 (n=1200)
- few-shot code tasks (n=200)
- instruction following (n=300)
Compare fp16 vs int8 vs int4-smoke. Flag any drop >3% for human review.

ravi: Timeline: smoke run today (ciara please deploy ephemeral infra), full sweep tomorrow AM, quant sweep after baseline complete. Can someone deploy GPU node pool tag monsoon-test?

ciara: Deploying now, ETA ~12m. bench-bot: create results folder and notify on completion.

bench-bot: created results/monsoon-13b/ and started smoke-run job id=bb-3045. ETA ~30m. Logs: http://ci.internal/logs/bb-3045

kai: Quick question — for int4-smoke do we use 4-bit GPTQ or nuq? Recommend trying q4_k_m or similar. @ravi any preference?

ravi: Start with GPTQ q4_k_m (existing infra path), but keep quant artifacts separate in s3 as monsoon/13b/quant/gptq-q4km/.

ellie: Note: add eval harness tags so we can diff: monsoon-13b/fp16 -> monsoon-13b/int8 -> monsoon-13b/gptq-q4km.

dana: Also add routing policy test: ensure fallback to smaller variant (e.g., monsoon-6b) when load spikes. We'll simulate 2x normal qps.

ravi: If smoke results look good I'll attach perf tables here. For now, blocked until bench job finishes. Thanks all :rocket:

ciara: bench job finished early — logs show first-pass throughput looks promising. bench-bot will upload summary.

bench-bot: summary uploaded: results/monsoon-13b/summary-2134567890.json

dana: great — assigning follow-ups: @ravi perf report, @ellie eval diff and triage, @ciara promote artifact to staging if green. I'll update model-catalog ticket.

ellie: Will start sampling failures and scheduling a quick human review session if any eval falls >3%.

ravi: Quick note — I saw a tail latency spike at ctx=2048 batch=1 on our P4 instance; adding to triage. snippet of logs:
```
[2026-03-20T09:12:03Z] tail-latency: 1220ms ctx=2048 batch=1 kernel=matmul_cu
```
Suspect memory-copy issue on cold KV; will reproduce with nvprof.

dana: thanks. keep thread updated. If anyone finds a quality regression that looks like quantization-induced, don't ship int8 for Dedicated until root cause.

kai: nice intake flow. small suggestion: add a short "golden prompts" set (10 prompts) we always run to catch regressions early.

ravi: added golden_prompts.txt to results/monsoon-13b/

ciara: closing infra loop, nodes tagged monsoon-test-2026-03-20.

bench-bot: reaction :white_check_mark:

dana: moving this to done for intake stage. We'll open a new thread for post-triage results. Thanks team :tada:
